description: One coin's dashboard: price, 24h/7d/30d change, market cap and rank, fully diluted value, volume, circulating/total/max supply, all-time high, the exchanges and DEX pools it trades on, its contracts, and the Animal Spirits meter. A coin we can name but have not built yet starts building and answers status=building (call again in a minute). No key. From EventTrader's crypto dashboards (cymetica.com/crypto). Every number carries its source and time; a number that failed a plausibility check is withheld, never guessed. Places no orders, moves no funds. Not financial advice.
